clue.text: Competitor deemed to be superior may have understood

definitions.text: Competitor deemed to be superior may have

to have grasped what someone meant

explanation.definitionFit: Grasping the argument is an idiom for having caught on; a scoring rally winner is literally credited with it.

clue.text: Good space editor prepared

clue.text: Models I read about deprived of confidence

clue.text: Disarray of some Ulster Protestants without leader falling into depression

clue.text: Relation who is bound to appear after death?

clue.text: Scared nob in disguise, one on the run

clue.text: Terrace that might provide some bovver and aggro

clue.text: Business folk — they may hand out cards

clue.text: After gym I have rolled over and shut up, being irritable
